verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (now LegalZoom Virtual Mail) documents an official MCP server. It connects Claude, Cursor and other MCP-compatible apps to the mailbox, supports natural-language reads and real actions (scan, shred, tag, move), and publishes a per-tool reference. A live machine-readable MCP tool catalog is also served at the API origin. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect your AI assistant to Virtual Mail and manage your virtual mailbox just by asking - find mail, organize your inbox, scan or shred items, and more - directly from Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible apps.
A machine-readable MCP tool catalog is served live at the API origin under /v2/.
